author: BernieSanders
text:
Over and over again, we hear that Medicare for All is just “too expensive.” That is demonstrably false.

Not only would my legislation save lives, it would save money.

This isn't just me talking. Hear it from leading healthcare experts at the Yale School of Public Health.
